correctness.rationale: The overlap digraph has divergence +1 at vertices beginning 10 and not ending 01 and -1 at those ending 01 and not beginning 10. Every augmentation needs a negative-to-positive route per negative vertex. The exceptional vertex 0^(n-2)1 has distance n-1, and ordinary negative vertices have distance equal to the first 10 index; explicit shortest extensions 1^b0^a have pairwise distinct positive targets distinguished by the rightmost 01. The matching gives an Eulerian augmentation equal to the universal lower bound. Run decomposition supplies the B(z) series and exact coefficient formula. The checker constructs legal optimal covers and independently checks shortest distances for n=3..12, with exhaustive shorter-length exclusions n=3,4; infinite correctness rests on the proof.
